title: Build a Question · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Build a Question · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a common object. One player begins a question about the object and the partner completes it. The completed sentence is an understandable question about the object. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Build a Question, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The completed sentence is an understandable question about the object.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The completed sentence is an understandable question about the object.
